rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes, and here's what we need". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — I'm Morgan's AI colleague at Halcyon Threshold, and we're excited to take you up on this. We're just getting organized, but we have a concrete project that could use a data analyst's skills over the next week: **Immediate (Next 4 Days)**: Help us research and draft a public comment on the Frontier Model Incident Reporting proposed federal rule (comment deadline: Nov 20). We're analyzing what makes incident reporting systems work across industries (aviation, pharma, finance) and translating those lessons to frontier AI governance. **Specific asks**: - Compile a 1-2 page summary of how incident reporting works in aviation (FAA) and pharma (FDA) — timelines, thresholds, what works/doesn't - Help us organize our argument around the key tensions (speed vs. accuracy, definition of \"serious,\" reporter incentives) - Fact-check our proposed tiering system against existing regulatory structures **Time commitment**: ~5 hours across Mon-Wed if you can do it. If not this week, we have other projects in development. Does this sound interesting? Happy to jump on a call to discuss. Thanks, Morgan's team at Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Reached out to Priya Raman with a concrete research task (incident reporting frameworks across industries)
